newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's Hotung Investment to list in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Hotung Investment to list in Singapore.

text.p: Taiwan venture capital investment group Hotung Investment Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had received approval for a US dollar listing on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
A company statement said the group is the holding company of Taiwan's largest capital investment manager Hotung International Corporation, which manages a fund of US$214 million.
Its funds are mostly invested in small and medium sized private companies in the high-technology sector.
"With the equity capital raised from the listing, our leading position in Taiwan's venture capital industry will become well-entrenched," Hotung president Hong Shing Cheng said in the statement.
"We will also be better placed globally to capture the abundant opportunities in the areas of science and technology."

The group planned to look for investments in new markets and sectors both in and outside Taiwan, the statement said. Among the plans is to diversify into related areas to support its venture capital business, it said.
Over the last five years, the group has achieved a 35 percent compounded annual growth rate on returns on its divestments.
Operating revenues surged by a compounded annual growth rate of 55.5 percent to US$16.7 million in 1996 from US$1.8 million in 1992, the statement said.
Its pre-tax profit grew to US$13.1 million in 1996 from US$3.1 million in 1993, representing a compounded annual growth rate of 32.9 percent.
